e20e5b56-b6da-50a3-8ab4-7aae2b23fb31.text:
EMPLOYEE MANUAL

Section 1: Employee Responsibilities

Employees must complete their assigned tasks on time.
Employees should communicate clearly with team members.
Employees must maintain work quality and productivity.

Section 2: Communication

Employees should use official email for company communication.
Important updates must be shared with the team.
Employees should attend scheduled team meetings.

Section 3: Performance

adf91f90-4546-5531-a749-46196303c92e.text:
Section 3: Performance

Employee performance will be reviewed regularly.
Managers will provide feedback and guidance.
Employees are encouraged to improve their technical skills.

f2e4734c-7ecb-5543-8981-105f4d69f5f1.text:
HR GUIDELINES

Section 1: Recruitment

All job applicants must complete the interview process.
HR will verify candidate qualifications.
Selected candidates will receive an offer letter.

Section 2: Employee Onboarding

New employees must complete onboarding training.
HR will explain company policies and procedures.
Employees must submit required joining documents.

Section 3: Employee Benefits

4e7c5494-97db-5441-9642-6244f98a9bc1.text:
Section 3: Employee Benefits

Employees are eligible for company benefits.
HR will provide information about insurance and benefits.
Employees can contact HR for benefit-related questions.

1f69fd1c-cc66-50bc-b524-c073ae0eeb81.text:
LEAVE POLICY

Section 1: Annual Leave

Employees are eligible for 12 days of annual leave per year.
Leave requests must be submitted in advance.
Managers must approve annual leave requests.

Section 2: Sick Leave

Employees can apply for sick leave when they are unwell.
Medical certificates may be required for extended sick leave.
Employees must inform their manager about sick leave.

Section 3: Leave Approval

4a4e9699-16e2-5077-b9ce-264dd888ca2a.text:
Section 3: Leave Approval

All leave requests must be submitted through HR.
Employees should check their leave balance before applying.
Unapproved leave may be treated as unauthorized absence.

ea051b12-4367-5496-8072-28d7f735cd4e.text:
COMPANY POLICY

Section 1: Working Hours

Employees must work 8 hours per day.
Office working hours are from 9 AM to 6 PM.
Employees must inform their manager if they arrive late.

Section 2: Attendance

All employees must mark attendance daily.
Employees should inform HR about attendance issues.
Repeated absence without permission may result in disciplinary action.

Section 3: Workplace Rules

e72983b6-b02b-5fce-ac16-4e451e25cd31.text:
Section 3: Workplace Rules

Employees must maintain professional behavior.
Company resources should be used responsibly.
Employees must follow company rules and regulations.

e0220eb2-b12c-516b-ada5-49b170fe36ab.text:
INFORMATION SECURITY POLICY

Section 1: Password Security

Employees must use strong passwords.
Passwords must not be shared with others.
Passwords should be changed regularly.

Section 2: Data Protection

Company data must be protected from unauthorized access.
Confidential documents must not be shared externally.
Employees must follow data protection guidelines.

Section 3: System Security

d0d1521a-9166-5ecc-83a6-bb064c749220.text:
Section 3: System Security

Employees must lock their computers when away.
Suspicious emails must be reported to IT.
Only authorized software should be installed.
